integrity: The new integer lattice claim is supported by a complete proof plus finite independent character checks; the verification does not constitute external independent mathematical auditing.
limitations: Only integral reduced homology as a module is classified, not equivariant homotopy. The rational and nonequivariant consequences are previously covered; an equivalent unindexed integral result remains a bibliographic risk.
title: Integral crown-graph lattice for two-subset Kneser neighborhood homology
